title: Deriving subdiffusion equations from general Renewal--Jump dynamics
summary: Subdiffusion occurs when long trapping or residence times of particles slow down spatial transport and produce a mean squared displacement proportional to $t^α$, with~$0<α<1$. We develop a general renewal--jump framework that combines the internal trapping dynamics with the reinjection of particles with spatial jumps. The internal trapping dynamics enters the macroscopic limit through the small-frequency behavior of a resolvent which limiting solution is not integrable.
